description: Amazon History KP: product Series API.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), only supports a single ASIN, the maximum length is 1000.

days.description: Limit the number of days of historical data to a maximum of `365`.

showBsrMain.description: Set to `1` to return the large class of BSR curves.

showPrice.description: Set to `1` to return the lowest new product price curve in the market.

showPriceCoupon.description: Set to `1` Returns the post-coupon Buy Box price curve.

showPriceDeal.description: Set to `1` to return the flash sale price curve.

showPriceFba.description: Set to `1` to return the third-party FBA new product price curve.

showPriceFbm.description: Set to `1` to return the third-party FBM new product price curve.

showPriceList.description: Set to `1` to return the strike/mark curve.

showPricePrime.description: Set to `1` to return Prime exclusive new product price curve.

showSellerCount.description: Set to `1` to return the seller number curve.
